caption: The drawing depicts a landscape with several distinct features and uses predominantly green, blue, and pinkish tones. At the top left, there is a coat of arms that features a blue shield with motifs and a white banner bearing a Latin motto. Below this is a winding stream bordered by rocky terrain, which curves around a grassy area. In the bottom left corner of the grassy area, there are two small rectangular red-orange structures. The center of the composition shows a grid-like arrangement of trees, each spaced evenly apart with green canopies and hints of shadow below. To the right, there is a formal garden area divided into four square sections with symmetrical, colorful flower beds arranged in geometric patterns. Further to the top right, there is a large white house with a red roof, tall windows, and trees in the background, with a path leading to it. The drawing is bordered by a pale beige margin with the artist's signature, "Gilbert Sackerman," in the lower right corner. The coastline and water are depicted along the lower edge and left side with blue and turquoise shades.
title: I. Beekman Estate
